prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1359; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a low-speed head-on collision reported by the insured. Insured reports vehicles made contact at reduced speed in a parking area. Insured's vehicle sustained front-end damage. Other driver reports neck stiffness and headache at scene and was transported by ambulance to a local hospital. Preliminary liability appears clear pending statements. Photos requested from both parties.

Entry 2: Claimant's representing attorney has contacted the office and requested that all communications be directed to counsel going forward. Letter of representation received and logged. Claimant's medical records show a diagnosis of concussion with post-concussive symptoms including dizziness and light sensitivity. Reserve adjusted to reflect bodily injury exposure. Recorded statement from claimant deferred at counsel's request.

Entry 3: Police report obtained. Responding officer documented both vehicles with minor front-end damage and no citations issued. Witness statement from a pedestrian indicates the claimant's vehicle crossed the centerline briefly before impact. Liability allocation under review. Independent appraisal scheduled for both vehicles.

Entry 4: Counsel submitted medical summary requesting review of treatment to date, including neurology follow-up and cognitive screening. Medical bill review initiated. Claimant has missed several days of work per counsel's letter; wage verification documents requested. Nurse case manager assigned to monitor recovery progress and treatment plan.

Entry 5: Independent medical review completed. Reviewer notes the concussion diagnosis is consistent with the mechanism of impact and recommends continued monitoring. Settlement discussion with counsel scheduled. Liability position remains under evaluation pending final witness follow-up. File flagged for supervisor review before any offer is made.
